data.rationale: The proposal follows the same OpenTable → Allrecipes → Notes sequence with the right parameters and note template. It omits the "4+ stars" recipe filter, the "don't click a time slot or Reserve" constraint, and the step of opening the first restaurant. It also adds details such as London, 20:00 and a "Save the note" step, so it is mostly automatable but a little imprecise.
